#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
B="http://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT:-3110}/api"
J='Content-Type: application/json'
req() { curl -s -o /tmp/rb-checks/body -D /tmp/rb-checks/hdr -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
show() { echo "== $1 -> $2 | replayed=$(grep -ci '^idempotency-replayed: true' /tmp/rb-checks/hdr) | $(head -c 330 /tmp/rb-checks/body)"; }
field() { node -e "const b=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/rb-checks/body','utf8'));console.log(eval('b.'+process.argv[1]))" "$1"; }
key() { uuidgen | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'; }

s=$(req "$B/rooms?limit=100"); ROOM=$(field 'items[0].id'); ROOM2=$(field 'items[1].id'); echo "rooms=$s"
body() { echo "{\"roomId\":\"$1\",\"title\":\"$2\",\"organizerEmail\":\"$3\",\"startsAt\":\"$4\",\"endsAt\":\"$5\"}"; }
GOOD=$(body "$ROOM" "Standup" "ana@example.com" "2030-01-01T10:00:00+02:00" "2030-01-01T11:00:00")

echo "### 8.2 bookings-api"
K1=$(key); s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$GOOD"); show "create" "$s"; ID=$(field id)
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$GOOD"); show "overlap create" "$s"; ID2=$(field id)
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$ROOM2" Other bo@example.com 2030-02-01T10:00:00Z 2030-02-01T11:00:00Z)"); show "create room2" "$s"; ID3=$(field id)
s=$(req "$B/bookings"); echo "== list -> $s total=$(field total) page=$(field page) limit=$(field limit) n=$(field items.length)"
s=$(req "$B/bookings?roomId=$ROOM2"); echo "== list room2 -> $s total=$(field total)"
s=$(req "$B/bookings?page=2&limit=2"); echo "== list p2 l2 -> $s n=$(field items.length)"
for q in "page=0" "limit=101" "roomId=abc" "roomId="; do s=$(req "$B/bookings?$q"); show "list $q" "$s"; done
s=$(req "$B/bookings/$ID"); show "read" "$s"
s=$(req "$B/bookings/not-a-uuid"); show "read malformed" "$s"
s=$(req -X PATCH "$B/bookings/$ID" -H "$J" -d '{"title":"Retro","organizerEmail":"x@example.com"}'); show "patch title+unknown" "$s"
s=$(req -X PATCH "$B/bookings/$ID" -H "$J" -d '{}'); show "patch empty" "$s"
s=$(req -X PATCH "$B/bookings/$ID" -H "$J" -d '{"startsAt":"2030-01-01T12:00:00Z"}'); show "patch start past end" "$s"
s=$(req -X PATCH "$B/bookings/$ID" -H "$J" -d '{"startsAt":"2030-03-01T12:00:00Z","endsAt":"2030-03-01T13:00:00Z"}'); show "patch times" "$s"
s=$(req -X PATCH "$B/bookings/$(key)" -H "$J" -d '{"title":"x"}'); show "patch unknown" "$s"
s=$(req -X DELETE "$B/bookings/$ID2"); echo "== delete -> $s bodybytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/rb-checks/body)"
s=$(req -X DELETE "$B/bookings/$ID2"); show "delete again" "$s"
s=$(req "$B/bookings/$ID2"); show "read deleted" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$(key)" T ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T11:00:00Z)"); show "unknown room" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$ROOM" T ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z)"); show "equal times" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$ROOM" T ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T09:00:00Z)"); show "end before start" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$ROOM" T not-an-email 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T11:00:00Z)"); show "bad email" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$ROOM" T ana@example.com 2030-W01-1 2030-01-08T11:00:00Z)"); show "week date" "$s"

echo "### 8.3 idempotency"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -d "$GOOD"); show "missing key" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: abc" -d "$GOOD"); show "malformed key" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -d '{}'); show "missing key + bad body" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$GOOD"); show "replay (booking was patched since)" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$(body "$ROOM" Changed ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00+02:00 2030-01-01T11:00:00)"); show "different title" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$(body "$ROOM" Standup ana@example.com 2030-01-01T08:00:00Z 2030-01-01T11:00:00)"); show "same instant written differently" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$(body "$(key)" Standup ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00+02:00 2030-01-01T11:00:00)"); show "different body unknown room" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$(body "$ROOM" Standup ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z)"); show "invalid body on completed key" "$s"
K2=$(key)
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K2" -d "$(body "$ROOM" T ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T09:00:00Z)"); show "K2 invalid" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K2" -d "$(body "$(key)" T ana@example.com 2030-01-01T10:00:00Z 2030-01-01T11:00:00Z)"); show "K2 unknown room" "$s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K2" -d "$GOOD"); show "K2 valid afterwards" "$s"; ID4=$(field id)
s=$(req -X DELETE "$B/bookings/$ID4"); echo "== delete K2 booking -> $s"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K2" -d "$GOOD"); show "replay after delete" "$s"
s=$(req "$B/bookings/$ID4"); show "read deleted" "$s"

K3=$(key); PAR=$(body "$ROOM2" "Parallel-$K3" par@example.com 2031-01-01T10:00:00Z 2031-01-01T11:00:00Z)
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  curl -s -o "/tmp/rb-checks/p$i.body" -D "/tmp/rb-checks/p$i.hdr" -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K3" -d "$PAR" > "/tmp/rb-checks/p$i.code" &
done
wait
for i in $(seq 1 10); do echo "$(cat /tmp/rb-checks/p$i.code) replayed=$(grep -ci '^idempotency-replayed: true' /tmp/rb-checks/p$i.hdr) $(grep -o '"errorCode":"[^"]*"' /tmp/rb-checks/p$i.body)"; done | sort | uniq -c
s=$(req "$B/bookings?roomId=$ROOM2&limit=100"); echo "== bookings titled Parallel-$K3: $(grep -o "Parallel-$K3" /tmp/rb-checks/body | wc -l)"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K3" -d "$PAR"); show "retry after parallel" "$s"

echo "### 8.4 confirmation"
mk() { s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(key)" -d "$(body "$ROOM" Conf "$1" 2032-01-01T10:00:00Z 2032-01-01T11:00:00Z)"); field id; }
A=$(mk ana@example.com); R=$(mk ana@retry.example); X=$(mk ana@bounce.example); U=$(mk ana@BOUNCE.EXAMPLE)
D=$(mk ana@retry.example); s=$(req -X DELETE "$B/bookings/$D"); echo "deleted right after create -> $s ($D)"
sleep 0.6; s=$(req "$B/bookings/$R"); echo "retry between attempts: $(field confirmationStatus)/$(field confirmationAttempts)"
sleep 6
for p in "ordinary:$A" "retry:$R" "bounce:$X" "upper:$U"; do s=$(req "$B/bookings/${p#*:}"); echo "${p%%:*}: $(field confirmationStatus)/$(field confirmationAttempts)"; done
s=$(req "$B/bookings/$ID"); echo "first booking after job: $(field confirmationStatus)/$(field confirmationAttempts) title=$(field title)"
s=$(req -X POST "$B/bookings" -H "$J" -H "Idempotency-Key: $K1" -d "$GOOD"); show "replay after SENT" "$s"
echo "deleted booking id for log check: $D"
